content: 01.01 "1818 – Mary Shelley's novel 'Frankenstein', a masterpiece of Gothic horror and science fiction, was published."
02.01 "1920 – Isaac Asimov was born (works: Foundation Series, I, Robot, The Bicentennial Man)."
03.01 "1892 – J.R.R. Tolkien was born (works: The Hobbit, The Lord of the Rings, The Silmarillion)."
04.01 "1643 – Isaac Newton was born (contributions: Laws of Motion, Universal Gravitation, Calculus)."
05.01 "1933 – Construction began on the Golden Gate Bridge, an icon of Art Deco architecture in San Francisco."
06.01 "1838 – Samuel Morse successfully tested the electrical telegraph for the first time."
07.01 "1610 – Galileo Galilei observed Jupiter's four largest moons, revolutionizing astronomy."
08.01 "1935 – Elvis Presley was born (hits: Jailhouse Rock, Hound Dog, Can't Help Falling in Love)."
09.01 "2007 – Steve Jobs introduced the first iPhone, changing modern communication."
